# Webhooks

The person does these in the Whatsable app. Give the path and the steps; never say you did it. Fetch the "Full steps" address for the exact steps, or give the person the link.

## Send events to your own URL

- **What it is:** Send incoming and outgoing messages to a URL you run.
- **Plan:** Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins.
- **Where:** Settings > Webhooks
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/webhooks.md, section "add-an-endpoint". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/webhooks#add-an-endpoint

## Per-conversation automations

- **What it is:** Per chat: always send it to your automations, never, or pause while the team replies.
- **Plan:** Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial. It shows only when an incoming-message webhook exists.
- **Who can do it:** The docs name no role: it is in the contact panel of a conversation.
- **Where:** Inbox > the contact panel > Automations
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/webhooks.md, section "pause-when-your-team-replies". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/webhooks#pause-when-your-team-replies

## Receive webhook events in your own code

- **What it is:** Every field Whatsable posts from Settings, Webhooks, which shape includes it, and when the value is empty or missing.
- **Plan:** Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** Owners and admins.
- **Where:** Settings > Webhooks
- **The agent can:** nothing here; the person does it in the app.
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/api-reference/webhook-events.md. For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/api-reference/webhook-events
